In the other edition, Q2 is null (rho -0.02, p 0.78), but Q3's stand-in (ICIT period/phase lots) meets the survive bar (chi2 64.6, p 0.0048). This is the period/batch drift m328_measure had already reported (p 0.005), not find-spot clustering, which stays refuted.
